metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Bryce Canyon National Park appear lower compared to Las Vegas during 2024?

data.raw_code: The user is asking: "Does the nighttime light intensity in Bryce Canyon National Park appear lower compared to Las Vegas during 2024?" We need to: 1. Search strategy: Use nighttime light data (VIIRS) for 2024. - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A4" (monthly composites) or "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2" (daily) - Band: "DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL" for nighttime lights - Date: 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 - Locations: - Bryce Canyon National Park (roughly 37.628°N, 112.167°W) - Las Vegas (roughly 36.1699°N, 115.1398°W) 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights (they're already processed composites). 3. Logic: - Get mean nighttime light intensity for each location in 2024 - Compare if Bryce Canyon < Las Vegas - Need to handle cases: no data, no valid pixels, calculation failures - Output A (Yes) or B (No) based on comparison Let me structure the code: 1. Define two geometries (circles around each location) 2. Get VIIRS monthly composites for 2024 3. Check if collection has data 4. Compute mean nighttime light for each location 5. Validate results (not NaN, reasonable range) 6. Compare and output answer Potential issues: - Need to use appropriate scale (1000m) - Handle case where collection has 0 images (try alternative?) - Check if valid pixels exist Note: VIIRS monthly composite VNP46A4 is available from 2012-present. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometries for Bryce Canyon and Las Vegas const brycePoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.167, 37.628]); const vegasPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-115.1398, 36.1699]); // Buffer by 5km for area analysis const bryceArea = brycePoint.buffer(5000); // 5km radius const vegasArea = vegasPoint.buffer(5000); // 5km radius // 2. Define date range for 2024 const startDate = '2024-01-01'; const endDate = '2024-12-31'; // 3. Get VIIRS nighttime light monthly composites for 2024 const viirsCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A4') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'); // Nighttime light band // Check collection size const collectionSize = viirsCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 VIIRS Monthly Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("No nighttime light data found for 2024."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Compute mean image for the year const meanImage = viirsCollection.mean(); // 5. Extract mean nighttime light values for both locations const bryceStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: bryceArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const vegasStats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: vegasArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); // Get pixel counts to check for valid data const bryceCount = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bryceArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'); const vegasCount = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vegasArea, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'); // Get values const bryceValue = bryceStats.get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'); const vegasValue = vegasStats.get('DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'); // Evaluate const bryceVal = bryceValue.getInfo(); const vegasVal = vegasValue.getInfo(); const brycePixels = bryceCount.getInfo(); const vegasPixels = vegasCount.getInfo(); console.log(`Bryce Canyon - Mean NTL: ${bryceVal?.toFixed(2) || 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${brycePixels}`); console.log(`Las Vegas - Mean NTL: ${vegasVal?.toFixed(2) || 'null'}, Valid Pixels: ${vegasPixels}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (brycePixels === 0 || vegasPixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both locations."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (bryceVal === null || vegasVal === null || isNaN(bryceVal) || isNaN(vegasVal) || bryceVal < 0 || vegasVal < 0 || // Negative values unlikely for NTL bryceVal > 1000 || vegasVal > 1000) { // Unreasonably high console.log("Invalid or unreasonable NTL values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare values (nighttime light intensity) const bryceLower = bryceVal < vegasVal; console.log(`Comparison: Bryce (${bryceVal?.toFixed(2)}) < Vegas (${vegasVal?.toFixed(2)})? ${bryceLower}`); // Output final answer if (bryceLower) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
